mod.name: Custom Stamps
mod.description: Your own stamps for parcels: put PNG or JPG images into a folder, and they join the game's decorative and weight stamps. Every player in a game needs the same packs.

setting.Packs.Create.description: Makes a folder in BepInEx/plugins with stamps.txt, the folders decorative and weight and two sample stamps, and opens it. Put your PNG or JPG images there and press Reload.
setting.Packs.Reload.description: Reads every pack again after you added images or changed stamps.txt.
setting.Packs.Folder.description: Opens BepInEx/plugins, where the packs are.

setting.Stamps.Decorative.description: Images from the folder decorative. They are for beauty and change nothing in the game.
setting.Stamps.Decorative.empty: No PNG or JPG images in the folder decorative
setting.Stamps.Weight.description: Images from the folder weight. Each one counts as one unit of weight, like the game's own weight stamps.
setting.Stamps.Weight.empty: No PNG or JPG images in the folder weight

stamps.Created: {0}: a new stamp pack. Put PNG or JPG images into its folders and press Reload packs
stamps.NotSupported: {0}: only PNG and JPG images are read
stamps.TooMany: {0}: a pack takes at most {1} stamps of one kind
stamps.Duplicate: {0}: an image with the same name is already in the pack
stamps.NewPackDescription: My stamps for Cat Mail Co.
stamps.Template:
# Custom Stamps pack.
# Put PNG or JPG images into the folder "decorative" for decorative stamps
# and into the folder "weight" for weight stamps: each one counts as one unit of weight.
# Transparent edges are cut off, and the stamp keeps the shape of the picture.
# JPG images have no transparency, so they become rectangular stamps.
# Then press "Reload packs" on the Custom Stamps card in Settings, Mods.
# "outline: yes" draws a white border around each stamp, like the game's stickers; write no to turn it off.
#
# Below is the description of the pack. Thunderstore needs the version like 1.0.0.
name: {0}
version: 1.0.0
author:
description: {1}
outline: yes
